insights.summary: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 59% to ₹330 Cr with a 34.3% EBITDA margin and PAT of ₹75 Cr, as pharma intermediates grew 77% while specialty chemicals fell 11% on the planned exit from commodity products. Management repeated 25% revenue growth and FY26-like margins for FY27, said it is confident of beating ₹1,000 Cr CDMO revenue by FY28, and started commercial supply from the battery-chemicals plant. The Korean Indichem plant should be built by the end of Q2, with revenue from FY28.

what_changed.text: 25% revenue growth and stable margins for FY27
Confident of beating ₹1,000 Cr CDMO revenue by FY28
Third electrolyte additive capex now end of Q2 FY27 (was Q1)
Battery chemicals plant commercial; full capacity in about 3 years
10% of the electrolyte subsidiary given to business partner ARZ

tone.label: confident
tone.quote:
We are still very much confident to deliver 25% growth rate for the revenue as confirmed by the
CMD also.

analyst_questions.answer: Supply has started and will ramp each quarter; demand is not the limit, capacity is. No number given.
Specialty chemicals about 24%, pharma about 36% in Q1.
₹50 Cr spillover plus ₹40-45 Cr maintenance in FY27; R&D centre and land to be announced. Sachin is near full; Ankleshwar fills by FY28.
30-40 new molecules a year in development should dilute dependence on the anchor product over time.

red_flags.text: Specialty chemicals revenue fell 10.6% as commodity products are phased out, with a transition gap before new products ramp.
Other income fell to ₹1.8 Cr from ₹11 Cr; Q4 had ₹10 Cr of currency gains.
No split of CDMO vs core intermediates, so the anchor-product share can't be checked.
Working capital rose to 99 days from 91 on higher inventory.

EBITDA margin near 36% for the year
Battery chemicals revenue as the new plant ramps
Indichem plant completion by end of Q2

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Advanced pharma intermediates and CDMO; specialty chemicals including battery electrolyte additives and semiconductor (photoresist) chemicals
business_snapshot.customers: Global innovators and generic makers; battery makers in North America, Korea and elsewhere; Heraeus and Japanese/Korean chip-chemical buyers
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: Pharma intermediates ₹293 Cr and specialty chemicals ₹37 Cr in Q1 FY27; pharma was 87% of FY26
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Anchor CDMO product growth, generic launches (apixaban), tight global supply of battery additives, AI-driven memory-chip demand
